notes.title: Early Access 1.1 Patch
notes.notes:
This is the first proper patch to the game.   

- Added a way to return from loadout 
- Added core controls to options menu 
- Added disabled story button 
- Added version number to corner of menu 
- Fixed Quit button on lose menu 
- Fixed Standard build having incorrect starting stats 
- Started work on Core powers (still in progress)

If you encounter any issues, Join our discord and let me know!

https://discord.gg/VGaCPy38ta
